dogecoin.text: I think if #dogecoin #dogecoinrise or $BTC had teams leading their #crypto, it would be easy to believe in them, but they do not. Every business needs leadership, not just fans.

@WSBChairman @stoolpresidente If you don’t own #dogecoin, don’t call on your “doge people”. You are not one of them. @stoolpresidente put his money where his mouth is and can now call on us, his #safemoonarmy fam. There’s no crying in #crypto, grow a pair.
